reason: This case-control study compared prostate cancer patients with controls who had benign prostatic hyperplasia. It does not identify aggressive disease or establish an incident aggressive endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The three categories of selenium levels had odds ratios (OR) of 0.3 and a 95% confidence interval (CI) of 0.1-0.7 for group I, an OR of 0.6 and a CI of 0.3-1.1 for group II, and group III was used as the reference entity.
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate compares selenium levels between prostate cancer cases and benign-prostatic-hyperplasia controls without an aggressive disease definition.
